title: Amazon Nova 2 Sonic - AWS AI Service Cards
paper_type_zh: 云服务模型卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审查云端语音模型的数据、对齐、guardrails 和审计边界的读者
one_line: AWS's Nova 2 Sonic card discloses high-level multimodal sources, SFT/RL/RLHF, runtime filters, and evaluation layers but not records, rights, rewards, or reproducibility artifacts.
AWS 的 Nova 2 Sonic 服务卡披露了高层多模态来源、SFT/RL/RLHF、运行时过滤与评测层，但没有公开记录、权利、奖励或可复现制品。
why: A speech-model disclosure baseline separating high-level safety and alignment claims from unavailable audit evidence.
inclusion_reason: Cloud-provider speech-model service card that names source categories, SFT/RL/RLHF, filtering, and evaluation while withholding audit-critical data and reward artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Amazon Nova 2 Sonic is a managed speech-to-speech and speech/text service whose official Service Card describes how the deployed system is intended to be used and tested. For reasoning-data curation, the central question is narrower: what training records, feedback objects, filters, and evaluation artifacts are actually disclosed?

The card names multilingual and multimodal source classes, pretraining, SFT, reinforcement learning, RLHF, runtime filters, and several evaluation layers. It does not release the source records, rights map, preference examples, rewards, model checkpoints, rollout logs, or test sets. This entry therefore treats the report as a bounded frontier data-disclosure ledger, not as a reusable speech-model dataset or training recipe.

Amazon Nova 2 Sonic 是一项托管式语音到语音及语音/文本服务；官方 Service Card 主要说明部署系统的预期用途和测试方式。对推理数据策展而言，更具体的问题是：哪些训练记录、反馈对象、过滤器和评测工件被真实披露？

服务卡点名了多语种、多模态来源类别，以及预训练、SFT、强化学习、RLHF、运行时过滤和多层评测，但没有发布来源记录、权利映射、偏好样本、奖励、模型检查点、rollout 日志或测试集。因此，本条目把该报告作为有边界的前沿数据披露账本，而不是可复用的语音模型数据集或训练配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AWS describes a core multimodal transformer combined with a speech encoder and speech renderer. A deployed interaction turn contains model-level instructions, chat history, or tool definitions; speech or text input; and generated text and speech responses. That runtime object is concrete, but the stored post-training example schema remains unknown.

The disclosure boundary is a three-part control story: curate broad training-source classes, adjust weights with SFT and RLHF, and tune privacy, profanity, and safety filters. The report also refers to reinforcement learning in the model-development description. It does not identify the human-feedback record format, reward or verifier, preference aggregation, calibration, or terminal predicate, so the named stages must not be upgraded into an RLVR claim.

AWS 将系统描述为核心多模态 transformer 与 speech encoder、speech renderer 的组合。部署时的一轮交互包含模型级指令、对话历史或工具定义，语音或文本输入，以及生成的文本和语音响应。这个运行时对象是明确的，但后训练样本的存储模式仍为 unknown。

披露边界可概括为三类控制手段：策划宽泛的训练来源类别，以 SFT 和 RLHF 调整权重，并调节隐私、粗俗内容和安全过滤器。报告在模型开发描述中也提到 reinforcement learning，但没有说明人工反馈记录格式、奖励或验证器、偏好聚合、校准或终止条件，因此不能把这些阶段名称升级为 RLVR 主张。

title: Method
方法
html:
The official Service Card says the core transformer was trained on licensed, proprietary, and publicly available multilingual and multimodal data, then developed through pretraining, SFT, reinforcement learning, and RLHF. At runtime, Bedrock receives speech or text plus configuration, applies input-policy filters, generates text, and renders speech; a triggered filter instead returns an error or canned response. The built-in safety filters cannot be configured or disabled.

Development testing combines public and proprietary datasets, automated assessors, human evaluation, and third-party red teaming. Named examples include MLS, FLEURS, VoiceBench/IFEval, and voice-converted BFCL conversations, but the Service Card does not state that evaluation records were used for training. Source identities and mixtures, source-level rights, deduplication, preference protocol, rewards, filter thresholds, rollout sampling, optimization details, checkpoints, splits, and decontamination remain unknown.

官方 Service Card 称，核心 transformer 使用许可数据、专有数据和公开的多语种、多模态数据训练，随后经历预训练、SFT、reinforcement learning 和 RLHF。运行时，Bedrock 接收语音或文本及配置，先执行输入策略过滤，再生成文本并渲染语音；若过滤器被触发，则返回错误或预设响应。内置安全过滤器不能配置或禁用。

开发测试结合公开与专有数据集、自动评估器、人工评估和第三方红队。报告点名 MLS、FLEURS、VoiceBench/IFEval，以及将 BFCL 文本对话转成语音后的评测，但没有说明这些评测记录被用于训练。来源身份及配比、逐来源权利、去重、偏好协议、奖励、过滤阈值、rollout 采样、优化细节、检查点、数据划分和去污染仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary evidence is the official AWS Service Card, current for the December 2, 2025 release. It directly supports the multimodal speech architecture, source classes, SFT/RL/RLHF stages, non-configurable safety filters, deployment interaction flow, and the public/proprietary, human, and red-team evaluation layers. The official Bedrock model page confirms the service identity.

The report also gives selected unreleased safety results, such as more than 95% safe responses on a proprietary 8.5K-prompt toxicity set. Such results document AWS's evaluation surface and guardrail claim; they do not establish provenance, label quality, reward accuracy, decontamination, or the quality of the training data.

主要证据是适用于 2025 年 12 月 2 日版本的官方 AWS Service Card。它直接支持多模态语音架构、来源类别、SFT/RL/RLHF 阶段、不可配置的安全过滤器、部署交互流程，以及公开/专有、人工和红队评测层。官方 Bedrock 模型页确认了服务身份。

报告还给出部分未发布安全评测结果，例如在一个专有的 8.5K 条毒性提示集上，安全响应比例超过 95%。这些结果记录了 AWS 的评测表面和 guardrail 主张，但不能证明溯源、标签质量、奖励准确性、去污染或训练数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the contribution is not a new speech-data algorithm or open corpus. It is a provider-authored disclosure that connects a speech interaction object, broad source categories, named alignment stages, runtime filters, and evaluation layers in one document. That makes it possible to compare what is operationally visible with what an independent data audit would require.

The report is more specific about deployed I/O and evaluation than about post-training records and feedback. Preserving that asymmetry is the useful direction signal: service cards can expose control surfaces and risk tests while still withholding the examples, reward contract, and lineage needed to reproduce the model. The presence of RLHF is not itself novel and does not imply an auditable preference dataset.

对本图谱而言，其贡献不是新的语音数据算法或开放语料，而是一份由服务提供商撰写的披露文件：它在同一文档中连接了语音交互对象、宽泛来源类别、已命名的对齐阶段、运行时过滤和评测层，使读者可以比较可见的操作接口与独立数据审计实际需要的证据。

报告对部署 I/O 和评测的说明比对后训练记录与反馈的说明更具体。保留这种不对称性本身就是方向信号：服务卡可以公开控制表面和风险测试，同时仍不提供复现模型所需的样本、奖励契约和谱系。RLHF 的存在并非新方法，也不意味着存在可审计的偏好数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No manifest identifies training records, source quantities, mixture weights, revisions, or source-level rights. The report does not disclose the SFT schema, human-feedback instructions, preference pairs, reward model or function, verifier calibration, rollout pool, rejected candidates, optimizer, stage budgets, checkpoints, train/evaluation allocation, or decontamination. Evaluation prompts, labels, rubrics, splits, and red-team transcripts are also not released.

Runtime effectiveness depends on customer workflows, acoustic conditions, prompts, tools, and human judgment. The system may generate inaccurate content, and its built-in filters cannot be disabled. These deployment limitations are relevant to audit, but they should not be confused with evidence about the hidden training corpus or feedback quality.

没有清单标识训练记录、来源数量、混合权重、版本或逐来源权利。报告未披露 SFT 模式、人工反馈指引、偏好对、奖励模型或函数、验证器校准、rollout pool、被拒候选、优化器、阶段预算、检查点、训练/评测分配或去污染。评测提示、标签、rubric、划分和红队转录也未发布。

运行时有效性取决于客户工作流、声学条件、提示、工具和人工判断，系统也可能生成不准确信息，且内置过滤器无法禁用。这些部署限制与审计有关，但不能被混同为关于隐藏训练语料或反馈质量的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, this Card is useful for comparing speech-model disclosure against text-only and agent-system reports. It supplies a concrete checklist: interaction-turn fields, source classes, SFT/RL/RLHF labels, runtime filters, human evaluation, automated benchmarks, red teaming, and the missing record-level evidence behind each layer.

Researchers can use it to frame requests for source manifests, rights, preference schemas, reward contracts, filter evaluation, train/test separation, and versioned evaluation artifacts. It is not sufficient for constructing compatible training data, reproducing alignment, or treating reported benchmark and safety results as proof of data quality.

在 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger 分类中，本 Card 可用于把语音模型披露与纯文本或智能体系统报告进行比较。它提供一份具体检查表：交互轮次字段、来源类别、SFT/RL/RLHF 标签、运行时过滤、人工评估、自动基准、红队，以及每一层背后缺失的记录级证据。

研究者可据此提出审计请求，包括来源清单、权利、偏好模式、奖励契约、过滤器评测、训练/测试分离和版本化评测工件。它不足以构造兼容训练数据、复现对齐，也不能把所报告的基准与安全结果当作数据质量证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the interaction-turn definition and runtime filter flow separately from the undisclosed training-record schema.
  • Treat licensed, proprietary, and public data as source classes, not a manifest or rights audit.
  • Keep SFT, RL, and RLHF stage names separate from a disclosed reward/verifier contract.
  • Treat safety percentages and benchmark results as evaluation claims, not training-data quality evidence.

• 将交互轮次定义和运行时过滤流程，与未披露的训练记录模式分开阅读。
  • 将许可、专有和公开数据视为来源类别，而不是清单或权利审计。
  • 将 SFT、RL 和 RLHF 的阶段名称，与已披露的奖励/验证器契约区分开。
  • 将安全比例和基准结果视为评测主张，而不是训练数据质量证据。
